clue.text: Rise and dress

definitions.meaning: to get out of bed or stand up
an outfit, especially an odd or showy one

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb phrase it means to stand or leave bed; as a noun it is a costume or rig-out.

clue.text: Prospect for an Olympic hopeful?

parts.note: read literally it is a miner's activity, searching for the precious metal; read as sport it is an athlete's ambition to win first place

explanation.surface: Asking what future awaits a would-be Olympian.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes both panning for the yellow metal and an athlete aiming for the top medal.

clue.text: Evict all who answer the call to rally

definitions.meaning: to expel someone from their home

definitions.text: all who answer the call to rally
definitions.meaning: the number of people who attend a gathering

explanation.surface: A landlord throws out everyone who came to a protest.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb phrase it means to expel; as a noun it is the attendance at an event or vote.

clue.text: Where the goldfish are watched by kitty

definitions.meaning: a garden pond where ornamental fish swim
a shared fund of money, as in a card game

explanation.surface: Pet fish being eyed hungrily by the cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A pond holds ornamental fish, and a shared pot of stakes is also called by the same word.

clue.text: After something to drink had a meal to finish off

indicators.note: the meal piece is placed after the drink piece

parts.note: ate is the past tense of eat

explanation.surface: Someone has a drink, then dinner, then finishes things off.
explanation.definitionFit: To wind up a business, or to kill someone, is to finish it off.

clue.text: A frequent shoe model for a regal lady in a suit

indicators.note: to model is to shape, so these letters are moulded into a new form

explanation.surface: A shoe for a royal woman wearing a business suit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Model' looks like a fashion model or a type of shoe, but it signals the anagram of A FREQUENT SHOE. The 'suit' is a suit of playing cards.
explanation.definitionFit: A royal court card in the red suit of hearts is a queen, a regal lady.

clue.text: Before morning one married a leading Shiite

indicators.note: the pieces 'one married' come before the morning piece

parts.note: AM stands for ante meridiem, morning

explanation.surface: A Muslim cleric is wed early in the day.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior religious leader among Shia Muslims bears this title.

clue.text: Asked for a job and got put on

definitions.meaning: made a formal request for work
laid on a surface, as paint or a plaster

explanation.surface: Someone sought work and was taken advantage of.
explanation.definitionFit: One applies for a post, and paint is applied, or laid on, a wall.

clue.text: It must have happened in the Seventies

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the letters of the word Seventies

explanation.surface: A claim that something surely took place during the 1970s.
explanation.definitionFit: An occurrence is something that has happened.

clue.text: Backing righteousness till kingdom come

parts.note: to be for something is to support it

explanation.surface: Supporting virtue for all eternity.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means permanently, the same as an idiom for until the end of time.

clue.text: Daughter of chaste disposition goes to animal sanctuary in Africa

explanation.surface: A chaste young woman heads to a wildlife reserve on safari.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Goes to' simply links the pieces; the order is D, ARK, CONTINENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Victorian explorers called Africa by this nickname because so little of its interior was mapped.

clue.text: No longer sufficient to serve as a specimen

explanation.surface: Something that was once enough now serves only as a sample.
explanation.definitionFit: A specimen is a typical instance or illustration.

clue.text: Civil disorder caused by robbing charioteer of a cheer

indicators.note: robbing takes something away, so the letter A is removed
robbing someone of a thing strips it from them, so the cheer letters leave the word

explanation.surface: A rioting crowd stops a chariot driver's cheering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Robbing charioteer of a cheer' strips C, H, E, E, R and A from CHARIOTEER, leaving the letters RIOT.
explanation.definitionFit: A riot is an outbreak of public violence and lawlessness.

clue.text: Honest Carolingian

definitions.meaning: candid, outspoken
a member of the Germanic people ruled by Charlemagne's dynasty

explanation.definitionFit: The word means candid, and is also a member of the tribe whose dynasty was Charlemagne's.

clue.text: Gold plate as security

definitions.meaning: a thin covering of gold
a British government bond

explanation.surface: Gold dishes offered as collateral.
explanation.definitionFit: Gold leaf on a surface has this name, as do safe UK government bonds.

clue.text: Get ready to invest

definitions.meaning: as two words, to become prepared
in the old military sense, to surround or besiege

explanation.surface: Preparing to put money into something.
explanation.definitionFit: Split in two it means become prepared; whole, it means to besiege, which is the old sense of invest.

clue.text: Not the best way to beat an opponent

definitions.meaning: the poorest of all
to defeat

explanation.surface: Advice that this is a poor way to defeat a rival.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the superlative of bad, and also an old verb meaning to defeat.

clue.text: Ready to do house painting job which is awaiting execution

definitions.text: Ready to do house painting job
definitions.meaning: up on the platform of poles and planks builders use
on the platform where hangings took place

explanation.surface: A decorator up on the boards, or a condemned prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorator stands on a raised platform to work, and a condemned prisoner stood on one to be hanged.

clue.text: Final performance was yesterday evening

definitions.meaning: the closing show of a run
the evening just past

explanation.surface: A show closed after its run yesterday.
explanation.definitionFit: The closing show of a theatre run has this name, which also means the previous evening.

clue.text: On board, back rules calling for firm action

parts.note: the stern is the back of a ship

explanation.surface: Ship's officers say the regulations at the rear call for decisive steps.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe steps taken to deal with a problem are strict, firm action.

clue.text: Lay the logs and light them

definitions.meaning: arrange a fire ready in the grate
to ignite, as in ... to

explanation.surface: Instructions for building and lighting a log fire.
explanation.definitionFit: One readies a hearth by arranging the fire, and kindles it by igniting it.

clue.text: Stays teasing someone

definitions.meaning: the ribs of a corset
good-natured mockery

explanation.surface: Someone remains, mocking a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Corset bones are a form of rib work, and gentle mockery is also the word.

clue.text: Set teas more than satisfy the appetite

indicators.note: set as in arranged, so the letters are put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Laid-on afternoon teas that fill everyone up.
explanation.definitionFit: To glut or satiate someone is to feed them beyond full.

clue.text: Confounded weeds in the vegetable patch

indicators.note: confounded means mixed up, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Annoying weeds growing among the garden produce.
explanation.definitionFit: A swede is a root crop, a yellow turnip.

clue.text: Liberal artist shows sign of balance

explanation.surface: A Liberal painter displays a scale.
explanation.definitionFit: The zodiac sign of the scales represents balance.

clue.text: Appeal to prohibit port in the land of whisky

definitions.text: port in the land of whisky

parts.note: O is an exclamation used in calling on someone, as in 'O Lord'

explanation.surface: A plea to ban something in a Scotch-drinking country.
explanation.definitionFit: A west coast Scottish harbour town famed for its distillery.

clue.text: Prophet is right to support episcopal division

indicators.note: in a down clue the right piece sits under, supporting, the see piece

parts.note: a bishop's see is his diocese

explanation.surface: A prophet rightly backs a split among bishops.
explanation.definitionFit: One who foretells the future is a seer.

clue.text: Protected minor hospital wing

definitions.meaning: a child under a guardian
a room or section for patients

explanation.surface: A child under care is in a hospital section.
explanation.definitionFit: A child under guardianship has this name, as does a hospital room for patients.

clue.text: It doesn't look good for a spell

definitions.text: It doesn't look good for a spell

parts.words: It doesn't look good for a spell
parts.note: seemingly about something looking bad for a while; really a malevolent glance that casts a curse

explanation.surface: Things appear bleak for a short time.
explanation.definitionFit: A malicious glance believed to put a curse on its target.

clue.text: Officially authorising slaughter of marine mammals

definitions.meaning: putting a seal on a document
the hunting of seals

explanation.surface: Approving a seal cull.
explanation.definitionFit: Stamping a document makes it official; hunting seals has the same name.

clue.text: Former Euro grouping censured and damned

parts.note: to rate is to scold angrily

explanation.surface: An ex-member of a European bloc is condemned and cursed.
explanation.definitionFit: To curse or loathe someone is to call down damnation on them.

clue.text: A number telling how to turn over the bed

definitions.meaning: a single figure from 0 to 9

definitions.text: telling how to turn over the bed
definitions.meaning: an instruction to fork over the garden bed

explanation.surface: Instructions for turning over a flower bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A single figure is a numeral; as two words it is an order to fork over garden soil.
